name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that upgrades AI coding assistants with memory, learned habits, and security checks, so the AI gets noticeably better the more you use it on a given codebase.
buyer: A power user of AI coding tools (senior engineer or dev-tools team) who wants their AI assistant to stop repeating the same mistakes and actually improve project-over-project.
business_use_cases: An engineering team standardizes on it to give every developer's AI assistant the same accumulated project knowledge.
A coding-agent SaaS product could license the harness improvements to differentiate their offering.
A dev-tools YouTuber/educator builds paid workshop content around 'supercharging your AI coding setup'.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid setup/consulting package that configures the harness across a team's repos and trains them on the workflow.

steal_this: Install it on your own most-used repo, document the before/after in a short case study, and use that as marketing for AI-tooling consulting gigs.
